create_MinitaurBallGymEnv: create a MinitaurBallGymEnv instance with self collision enabled and leg model for steering control
reset_MinitaurBallGymEnv: reset the minitaur ball gym environment and load a ball at a random initial angle
get_observation_MinitaurBallGymEnv: get the ball angle and distance relative to the minitaur base as an observation vector
apply_steering_to_locomotion: apply a steering action to generate sine-based feedforward walking gait commands for the minitaur
compute_reward_MinitaurBallGymEnv: compute the reward based on ball distance with a bonus for reaching the goal threshold
